sentences.en: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
sentences.zh: 如果他能做到那一点，我愿意吃下这顶帽子。

sentences.en: And when you talk to me, take off your hat.
sentences.zh: 和我说话时，把你的帽子摘下来。

sentences.en: There were no hats in that store that fit me.
sentences.zh: 那家店里没有适合我的帽子。
